import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        String[] firstLine = br.readLine().split(" ");
        int n = Integer.parseInt(firstLine[0]);
        int m = Integer.parseInt(firstLine[1]);
        String[] aLine = br.readLine().split(" ");
        long[] a = new long[n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            a[i] = Long.parseLong(aLine[i]);
        }

        int mid_point = n / 2;

        List<Long> half1 = new ArrayList<>();
        List<Long> half2 = new ArrayList<>();

        generateSumsLeft(a, 0, 0, mid_point, m, half1);
        generateSumsRight(a, mid_point, n, 0, m, half2);

        Set<Long> setHalf1 = new HashSet<>(half1);
        List<Long> sortedHalf1 = new ArrayList<>(setHalf1);
        Collections.sort(sortedHalf1);

        long bestTotal = 0;

        for (long val : half2) {
            int idx = Collections.binarySearch(sortedHalf1, m - val);
            if (idx < 0) {
                idx = -idx - 1;
            }
            if (idx > 0) {
                long candidate = sortedHalf1.get(idx - 1) + val;
                if (candidate > bestTotal) {
                    bestTotal = candidate;
                }
            }
        }
        System.out.println(bestTotal);
    }

    private static void generateSumsLeft(long[] a, int i, long total, int limit, int m, List<Long> half1) {
        if (i == limit) {
            half1.add(total);
        } else {
            generateSumsLeft(a, i + 1, (total + a[i]) % m, limit, m, half1);
            generateSumsLeft(a, i + 1, total, limit, m, half1);
        }
    }

    private static void generateSumsRight(long[] a, int start, int end, long total, int m, List<Long> half2) {
        if (start == end) {
            half2.add(total);
        } else {
            generateSumsRight(a, start + 1, end, (total + a[start]) % m, m, half2);
            generateSumsRight(a, start + 1, end, total, m, half2);
        }
    }
}
